raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/Providers/: +44 for recording a failed turn where the reader will find it. A failed turn left its question orphaned: the assistant row stayed empty, the journal projection deletes an empty `.failed` row as a placeholder, and the only account of the failure was the provider-wide `errorMessage` — dismissible, overwritten by the next turn, gone on relaunch. What the reader is told, which endings count as failures, and what the row persists all moved out to `ChatTurnFailureNotice`; the provider keeps only the three things that are its own state — stamping the row before the journal is finalized, giving the composer its text back, and refusing a second concurrent send out loud instead of silently. The refusal cannot move out: `isSending` and the bridge send lock are this type's state and INV-6 gives them one owner. Also adds `revokeActiveTurn(reason:)`, extracted from `stopAgent`, and routes the three transcript resets through it. Those resets blanked `messages` while leaving `isSending` true, `activeTurnOwner` set and the send lock held, so every later send was rejected as "already sending", Stop could not clear it, and the abandoned turn's late result still ran the visible-completion path against rows that no longer existed — a turn that silently vanished while telemetry and the success chime reported success. INV-6 requires one revocation authority in this type: moving it out would give an in-flight turn two owners, which is the defect.
